notes.title: 🛠️ Sweet Toys Simulator – Patch Notes (v1.1)
notes.content:
Hello sweet players! 🍭 With this update, we’ve fixed several bugs and made meaningful improvements based on your valuable feedback to make the game even more fun. Here are the details:

💳 Payment System
🔢 Numpad (numeric keypad) support has been added — now you can enter card payments quickly using your keyboard!

🧾 Cashier and XP System
👩‍💼 The cashier now earns XP from automatic sales! Experience points are now properly awarded.
🪙 Level and license systems have been rebalanced for fairer and smoother progression.

🐞 Bug Fixes
🧹 Fixed object placement issues and minor scene bugs.
🧠 The save system is now more secure and stable.
❗ Customers no longer randomly show emojis and leave the store without reason — their behavior is now more logical 😄

🎨 Usability & Community Feedback
🖥️ Text size on the cash register screen has been increased for better readability.
💬 Various small tweaks were made based on community feedback. We truly listen to each and every one of you ❤️

Thanks so much for your support!
Your suggestions mean the world to us ✨
Keep playing, sharing, and helping us make the game better every day!
